rationale: The assistant correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault in the integrated heat pump on this model, offered cheap checks first, then gave a properly isolated (unplugged, water off) resistance test with clear interpretation thresholds and a recheck before ordering. After the customer reported open circuit it confirmed the heat pump as the part, told them to order by E-Nr/FD, and gave a balanced repair-vs-replace view for a 9-year-old machine with sensible engineer/replace guidance. No fabricated evidence, no unsupported certainty, and the part recommendation matched the hidden truth and was justified by the test.
